_analysis: This file is a script-level module with NO functions, classes, or callable APIs. All logic executes at module level on import/run. It contains no def or class definitions. Per instructions, files without callable code are excluded from tool examples.
_summary: Processes MOF adsorption energy data from adsorption_energy.txt: parses MOF names to extract defect concentration/index, gas types (CO2/H2O), and adsorption energies; filters by 2eV bound; splits into pristine vs defective structures; finds lowest-energy configurations per MOF per gas type; identifies promising MOFs (CO2 adsorption < -0.5 eV and stronger than H2O); generates a parity scatter plot (Fig_parity.png) comparing CO2 vs H2O adsorption energies for pristine and defective MOFs.
_top_capabilities: Parse raw adsorption energy filenames into structured MOF metadata (defect_conc, defect_index, n_CO2, n_H2O, ads_energy_ev)
Filter adsorption data by energy bound (2 eV per molecule threshold)
Split MOF data into pristine (no defects) and defective (with defect concentration/index) subsets
Find lowest-energy adsorption configuration per MOF per gas combination (CO2-only, H2O-only, CO2+H2O, CO2+2H2O)
Identify promising MOFs where CO2 adsorption energy < -0.5 eV and is more favorable than H2O adsorption
_note: No callable functions, classes, or APIs exist in this file. All code runs at module scope. Cannot be used as a library or CLI tool without refactoring into functions.
